senses.gloss: Minus (in this sense used with numerals); एकोन less by one; ˚विंशतिः 2 minus 1 = 19; so ˚त्रिंशत् 29; ˚पञ्चाशत् 49; अष्टोनं शतम् 1 minus 8 = 92. -Comp. -अतिरिक्त a. Too little or too much. -अब्दिकम् The श्राद्ध ceremony on the previous day before the anniversary ceremony. -रात्रः, -रात्रिः N. applied to a particular lunar day (which is omitted if two lunar days end in one solar day); Sūrya 1.4.
